transcription.warning: HUMAN_VERIFIED — approved by the repository owner (@marinoscar) on 2026-09-02 (issue #212, PR #214). Basis of approval, recorded precisely so a later reader can judge its weight: the 128 questions, the 8 categories and every static answer were transcribed from the text layer of the official USCIS document M-1778 (09/25), “128 Civics Questions and Answers (2025 version)”, downloaded 2026-09-02 from the sourceUrl above, with provenance.sha256 recording the exact bytes read; the transcription was then checked by re-parsing that same source text with an independent parser and diffing every prompt, every static answer and every senior-eligible flag against this file, which reported zero mismatches and independently derived the same 20 asterisked questions. The owner reviewed and approved that record. This was an owner sign-off on a machine transcription plus an automated source diff — it was NOT an independent page-by-page human re-read of the PDF, and this note says so rather than implying a stricter check than the one performed. Three things a later reviewer should still weigh: (1) the 8 dynamic questions (Q23, 29, 30, 38, 39, 57, 61, 62) carry explicit “[DRAFT PLACEHOLDER]” text and never an invented officeholder name — the source itself prints no name, deferring to uscis.gov/citizenship/testupdates or “Answers will vary.”; these are operational data to be maintained through PUT /api/civics/dynamic-answers and are NOT certified by this status. (2) Q62's 56 per-state capitals are not from the source document; each such row's own sourceNote discloses that. (3) Q39 (Vice President) and Q57 (Chief Justice) are dynamicScope “national” here, a deliberate divergence from civics-2008.json's “none” scoping, because the 2025 source defers both to testupdates — not an inconsistency to “fix”.
